name: ar-ghost-catcher
description: Mobile-first multiplayer Halloween AR ghost hunt

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ghost-hunt/shared && npm run build -w @ghost-hunt/server && npm run build -w @ghost-hunt/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @ghost-hunt/web" "npm run dev -w @ghost-hunt/server"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @ghost-hunt/web" "npm run start -w @ghost-hunt/server"
